mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; Barrot V3 remains the execution and verification foundation.

findings.detail: Main is 2ebf05cf7bf991a9c45f87ba25dda10d61c7d2c8. Two commits beyond the base of PRs #1338, #1339, #1340 and #1341 modify only AUTONOMOUS_DEPLOYMENT_REPORT.md and ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json; neither overlaps those PRs' changed paths.

PR #1341 head 5770f45f3393517bbe9659f977fbff455860c92c passed core CI run 40921198690 and fail-closed gate 40921198670. It adds a path-limited push trigger for the approval workflow, a read-only no-op push job, and confines pull-requests:write to the manual approval job. This mitigates only matching push events; it does not establish the root cause of prior historical zero-job runs.

Main signal remains timestamped 2026-10-29T13:23:33Z with score 44, confidence 0.0, news score 88 from 11 entries, missing GitHub model credentials and Groq HTTP 429. It is not a valid price forecast.

Main public summary still narrates mixed/modestly positive sentiment and references audio despite zero confidence and provider failures. PR #1340's exact-head CI and gate passed but the PR remains draft/unmerged.

Paper trader is workflow_dispatch-only, not cron-scheduled. Persisted state has a nonzero position_size 0.012445158497236623 and position_product null, cash 9009.9366 and trade_count 126. A successful manual run can push state/log; no dispatch or repair occurred.

Current merge queue still grants contents/pull-request write permissions, permits mode=all, defaults dry_run=false and max_prs=0 (unlimited), and contains merge-capable commands. PR #1335 is not merged.

Liqwall reports $1.41B OI at 12:32 UTC, TradRadar $2.00B at 13:00 UTC, and Coinperps $2.89B at 04:04 UTC with a contrary 0.82 long/short account ratio. Timestamp, venue and aggregation scopes are incompatible; no derivatives feature was admitted.

Tokyo SBIC East Japan is an official SME investment-development company. Its official site also documents a ChatGPT/generative-AI training seminar. This establishes neither an OpenAI partnership nor a direct XRP/SBI Holdings relationship.

Coinbase Q3 results are scheduled for October 29 after market close, which is after this capture time. Circle Q3 results are scheduled for November 4 at 8:00 a.m. ET. No unreleased results or XRP price effects are inferred.

interpretation: The highest-impact safe finding is that main still has invalid/stale XRP signal artifacts and a mutation-capable manual paper trader with unidentified persisted position identity. PRs #1338 and #1340 have passing exact-head CI/gates but remain draft/unmerged. PR #1341's CI/gate pass supports a limited approval-workflow mitigation, not a resolved root cause. Three secondary derivatives panels disagree on open interest and long/short balance, so no market feature or forecast is admitted.
unknowns: No synchronized, reconciled XRP spot/perpetual panel or issuer-level ETF-flow reconstruction was admitted.
The $1.41B/$2.00B/$2.89B open-interest discrepancy is not reconciled to venue sets, timestamps, instrument types or methodology.
The root cause of historical push-event/zero-job approval-workflow runs remains unresolved; PR #1341's path-filtered push no-op is a mitigation proposal, not proof of cause.
The paper-trading position product remains null and must not be guessed or rewritten automatically.
The intended meaning of 'SBIC, ChatGPT SBIC' remains unresolved; Tokyo SBIC East Japan and its ChatGPT seminar are candidates, not proof of an XRP or OpenAI relationship.
The public YouTube inventory for Camilla/Kamilah Stephenson remains partial and identity equivalence remains unverified.
No live authentication or handoff test exists for all nine target AI/data platforms.
Coinbase Q3 results were not yet due at the capture time; Circle Q3 results remain scheduled for November 4.
